newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end weaker, undermined by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end weaker, undermined by Dow.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed sharply lower in thin volume with the bolsa clinging closely to Wall Street's early downward swing, said traders.
The late recovery in New York failed to sweep Chilean shares higher, although the Dow's recovery could give the local market a boost at the opening, said dealers.
"The improvement in the Dow could give the bourse a good tone tomorrow," said one broker.
The 40-share index ended down 1.29 percent at 114.57 points. The general index lost 0.7 percent to 5,301.12 points.
Turnover shrank from 15 billion pesos Friday to just nine billion pesos.
All large Latin American bourses retreated on investors' fears that the Federal Reserve will raise U.S. interest rates at its next policy-making meeting on March 25, said dealers.
"Local players are very concerned about the volatility over the Fed meeting," said one dealer.
Chilean stocks will continue hovering around 115 points until there is some news to give the market more direction, said dealers.

Losers included power investment company Enersis, down 2.64 percent at 258 pesos, copper products maker Madeco, down 2.18 percent at 1,120 pesos and telecom CTC which shed 1.84 percent to 2,940 pesos.
Winners included building company Besalco, up 3.92 percent at 2,650 pesos and copper mine Mantos which rose 2.78 percent to 925 pesos.
